scope: Remaining official-method mechanism boundaries; no completed experiment claims
implementation_policy: Independent attributed algorithms, no vendored novel upstream code or pretrained binaries

SFYOLO.architecture: Unchanged Oriented R-CNN/OrthoNet source; no YOLO head or detector-source retraining
implemented: Actual VGG/fitted decoder/F1/F2 TAM with code-defined style-first moment formula
Generic aerial decoder reconstruction/constraint objectives and 50:1 style/content moment objective
Decoder-first then recomputed F1/F2 Adam steps, frozen-encoder input gradients
Teacher weak-view hard OBB pseudos and Student frozen-TAM augmentation composed with common strong view
After-optimizer parameter EMA0.999; source/norm-eval buffers unchanged
Next-epoch Student<-0.5Student+0.5Teacher SSM, optimizer state retained
Completed exact-dataset/domain/seed TAM required; smoke/untrained TAM rejected

auxiliary_budget_proposal.scope: 12 isolated target domains x whole-pipeline seeds42/43/44
auxiliary_budget_proposal.data: Only each cell's target VAL images, independent content/style streams
auxiliary_budget_proposal.status: must be explicitly accounted for before GPU release; not started by this implementation

SFYOLO.one_epoch_boundary: SSM cannot influence the final Teacher after one detector epoch; label SF-YOLO our OBB reimplementation / one-epoch budget / SSM inactive. Do not invent subepochs or a final extra teacher update.
declared_corrections: Code TAM formula rather than inconsistent paper Eq2; general aerial loss branch
Consistent centered BGR convention for content/style and inverse conversion at detector boundary
Restore decoder output to original spatial dimensions; preserve detector padding and OBB geometry
Sorted IDs and deterministic independent shuffled streams, no entropy reseeding; not bitwise author replay
No fabricated random pseudo boxes on empty detections; no annotation-dependent loader/autoanchors/GT selection
Frozen norm-eval buffers are retained rather than blending integer/state buffers during SSM

weights.format: model dictionary, 26 numeric Sequential feature tensors
weights.observed_validation: Actual external binary loads strictly and produces64/128/256/512 VGG taps; CPU only, no training
weights.redistribution: No separate grant established; binary not committed or embedded in trained-component payloads

SFYOLO.status: implementation_available; auxiliary budget/resource decision and actual training/smokes pending

AASFOD.canonical_code_defaults: 20 MC passes; sigma0.8/top20%; class+box variance; local/global GRL; detection-only FNS; teacher retention0.99 every2500 one-based steps
AASFOD.required_bug_repairs: Exactly20 distinct stochastic draws, not duplicated first draw; integer floor top20% with reproducible ties
AASFOD.source_assumption: Fixed current head has no source-trained dropout. Stateless post-hoc dropout preserves checkpoint weights but is not the trained-dropout posterior; explicit approximation approval is required.
AASFOD.budget_boundary: No teacher updates in185/266 steps. Stage3-only Teacher remains source; stage4 reset Teacher contains stage3 Student but cannot incorporate FNS.
AASFOD.decision_required: Approve an explicit dropout/cadence/budget approximation or a genuinely budget-limited degenerate result; no silent per-step EMA or entropy surrogate

DRU.missing_axis: Variance of aligned logits across six source-supervised decoder depths. A single RoI prediction head/two hidden FCs does not supply this axis.
DRU.decision_required: Relax detector/source invariant or explicitly rename a new estimator DRU-inspired. Rotated geometry, MIC/history or untrained extra heads cannot establish faithful DRU.
